summary: Bionano Genomics filed an 8-K announcing the hiring of Alex Hastie, Ph.D. as Chief Scientific Officer, effective July 20, 2026. This is an executive appointment, not a forced departure, but the filing itself constitutes the event. No deal terms, prices, or premiums are involved. The company issued a press release (Exhibit 99.1) highlighting Dr. Hastie's foundational role in optical genome mapping and his return to lead scientific strategy. The filing is routine in nature but qualifies as a management change. What to watch: integration of Dr. Hastie into the leadership team and potential impact on R&D direction; no risk-arb angle.
